headline: 復活の混テキスト climbs to sixth on ARC-AGI-3

sections.text: 復活の混テキスト gained 5.58 points to reach 45.11, moving from 11th to 6th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move puts the team among the six highest-scoring entries; public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
